fire: Use case: stylized-concept. Create ONE transparent PNG sprite for an isometric city builder. Precise orthographic dimetric 2:1 projection (horizontal ground axes have slopes +0.5 and -0.5; vertical edges vertical; NO perspective convergence). Square canvas 1024x1024. Exact square plot projects to a diamond with vertices TOP (512,448), RIGHT (960,672), BOTTOM (512,896), LEFT (64,672). All paving, landscaping and ground MUST stay within this single perfect diamond. No thick plinth, no extruding steps or terraces, no shadow outside diamond. Building is inset from all four plot edges, with roof and upper floors naturally above ground. Front facade faces SOUTHWEST, down-left of image: main doors must be on the LEFT visible wall, which runs from leftmost corner diagonally down-right to the front corner. Right visible wall is the SIDE, never main entrance. Building walls and roof ridge follow exactly the same 2:1 axes as the plot. Detailed restrained pixel-art miniature style matching classic city building sprites, warm upper-left lighting. Fully visible roof and plot with generous transparent margin. No text or watermark. Red brick fire station, main facade on LEFT with two red garage doors and a small personnel entrance, one fire engine within the open garage. Low slate roof, small hose tower at rear. All driveway is on southwest/left side within plot.
